templates.title: Switch Library Manager Web
templates.name: switch-library-manager-web
templates.description: Manage your Nintendo Switch backup library from the browser: missing updates, DLC and games, upcoming releases, statistics, organizing, NSZ compression and an SD card planner. No keys or games are included: put your own prod.keys in the data folder.
templates.note: Open the app on the port you choose (3000 by default). Set PUID/PGID to the owner of your games folder.
